Subject: Re: [PATCH] documentation typo for Text::Wrap

Nicholas Clark  writes:

> On Wed, Oct 24, 2007 at 10:58:57AM +0200, David Landgren wrote:
> > H.Merijn Brand wrote:
> > >On Tue, 23 Oct 2007 21:43:29 +0200, David Landgren  
> > >wrote:
> > >
> > >>Minor documentation tweaks to code examples.
> > >
> > >Thanks, applied in change #32182.
> > >I did not up the version. did I need to?
> > 
> > I would say no, it's just POD.
> 
> In this case, I would say yes, possibly, because it happens that the last
> released version has the same VERSION:
> 
> $ grep VERSION /usr/local/lib/perl5/5.8.8/Text/Tabs.pm lib/Text/Tabs.pm 
> /usr/local/lib/perl5/5.8.8/Text/Tabs.pm:use vars qw($VERSION $tabstop $debug);
> /usr/local/lib/perl5/5.8.8/Text/Tabs.pm:$VERSION = 2005.0824;
> lib/Text/Tabs.pm:use vars qw($VERSION $tabstop $debug);
> lib/Text/Tabs.pm:$VERSION = 2007.1117;
> $ diff -q /usr/local/lib/perl5/5.8.8/Text/Tabs.pm lib/Text/Tabs.pm 
> Files /usr/local/lib/perl5/5.8.8/Text/Tabs.pm and lib/Text/Tabs.pm differ
> 
> 
> Except that I'm sort of cheating here, because if I showed the full diff, it
> would be clear that David's wasn't the only change to lib/Text/Tabs.pm
> So someone else should already have bumped the VERSION, at which point the
> answer would be "no".
> 
> Checking all of these things is just another part of the yak shaving that
> the pumpking gets to do.
> 

There's Porting/cmpVERSION.pl, which can check the module versions
between two perl distributions.

Regards,
        Slaven
